fns.desc: radius_msg_verify_das_req: os_memcpy(orig, attr+1, MD5_MAC_LEN) copies a fixed 16 bytes from the Message-Authenticator attribute payload without first checking attr->length is >= sizeof(*attr)+16. An attacker-controlled RADIUS message can supply a shorter Message-Authenticator attribute, causing an out-of-bounds read of adjacent buffer/heap memory.

radius_msg_verify_msg_auth: identical bug -- os_memcpy(orig, attr+1, MD5_MAC_LEN) reads 16 bytes from the Message-Authenticator attribute without validating attr->length first. Same attacker-controlled wire-data over-read as line 699.

radius_msg_add_mppe_keys: the send-key buf (os_malloc at line 1399) is never freed on the `if (encrypt_ms_key(...) < 0) return 0;` error path. sqc caught the twin leak of the recv-key buf at line 1444 (MEM12-C) but missed this identical pattern for the send-key buf just above it.
